name: Denmark
sources: GDP about $135bn and population 5.14m (World Bank / Danmarks Statistik, 1990).
Inflation 2.6% (Danmarks Statistik consumer price index, 1990). The krone was in the narrow ERM band against the D-Mark; Nationalbanken's discount rate stood near 9.5%.
Tax revenue 46% of GDP (OECD Revenue Statistics, 1990), second only to Sweden, and general government debt 58% of GDP.

Defence 2.0% of GDP (NATO defence expenditure series, 1990). Denmark's NATO membership carried the standing 1953 reservations against foreign bases and nuclear weapons on Danish soil in peacetime; the 1988 fodnotepolitik crisis over port visits is what forced that May's election.
Oil 0.12 mbd from the Danish North Sea (Dan, Gorm, Skjold), operated by the Maersk-led DUC.
Separatism 0.02 is Faroese and Greenlandic home rule; Greenland had already left the EC in 1985.
